column3: Fonts are kiko's Satoshi, Fraunces and JetBrains Mono, self-hosted from kiko's licensed files
column4: the owner asked for kiko's serif+sans structure; Google Fonts could not serve Satoshi or Fraunces, and self-hosting removes the third-party request
column5: web/public/fonts holds satoshi-variable.woff2, fraunces-latin.woff2, jetbrains-mono-400/500.woff2 and Satoshi-FFL.txt; @font-face in app.css; the Google Fonts link is gone from index.html
column6: web build serves the four files from the origin; superseded 2026-11-10: the kiko and lighter port was reverted on 2026-11-09 (row 280) and the client is back on the Doop canvas tokens, so this no longer describes the tree; web/public/fonts is gone and the app uses Geist and Geist Mono
